extracted.name: Easy Super Moist Banana Bread
instruction_lines: Start by mashing your bananas, then add all the wet ingredients to the banana.
Mix all the dry ingredients in a separate bowl and then combine it with the wet ingredients.
Mix everything together until the dry ingredients is completely incorporated with the wet ingredients. Grease your baking pan with oil or butter and put the mixture in the pan.
Bake in your preheated oven at 350 Degree Fahrenheit for about 50 minutes or until tooth pick comes out clean. Share and enjoy.
